description: This file defines a utility/helper class 'UserHelper' for managing user-related operations in integration tests for the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving users via REST API calls, as well as utility functions for generating user JSON payloads and handling roles and permissions within test scenarios.

classes.name: UserHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing user operations in integration tests, such as creation, deletion, updating, and role management, primarily through REST API interactions.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user with specified role and staff IDs, returning the resource ID. Deprecated methods indicate intended future refactoring.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Overloaded method to create a user with specified username and attribute, returns the response object.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a user using a PostUsersRequest object, returns the deserialized response.

methods.name: createUserWithJsonResponse
methods.description: Creates a user with a JSON payload, returning the raw JSON response.

methods.name: createUserForSelfService
methods.description: Creates a self-service user linked to a client ID.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Retrieves the user ID corresponding to a username by fetching the user list.

methods.name: getTestCreateUserAsJSON
methods.description: Generates a JSON string for creating a user with specified role and staff IDs.

methods.name: getTestCreateUserAsJSON
methods.description: Generated JSON string for creating a user with specific username and staff ID.

methods.name: getTestCreateUserAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON for creating a user with username, password, and other attributes.

methods.name: getTestUpdateUserAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON payload for updating user details.

methods.name: getTestCreateUserAsJSONForSelfService
methods.description: Creates JSON for a self-service user linked to a specific client.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a user by ID, returns the resource ID.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates a user's details with specified username.

methods.name: createRoleOperationURL
methods.description: Constructs the API URL for user operations based on user ID.

methods.name: getSimpleUserWithoutBypassPermission
methods.description: Prepares a request specification for a simple user without bypass permissions, creating the user if not existing.

methods.name: buildUserRequest
methods.description: Builds a PostUsersRequest object for user creation, including role and office info.

methods.name: createSimpleRole
methods.description: Creates a minimal role with certain permissions for testing.

methods.name: addRepaymentPermissionToRole
methods.description: Adds specific permissions (e.g., loan repayment and read permissions) to a role.
